description: Place an outbound AI phone call toward an objective. Returns a callId immediately; the call is conducted asynchronously. Poll get_call with that callId until status is terminal (completed | no_answer | voicemail | declined | failed).

accountNumber.description: Account/phone digits the enter_account_number tool keys deterministically (keypad chars only).

callbackNumber.description: Our callback DID digits the enter_callback_number tool keys (callback-to-AI mode).

callerId.description: Optional caller ID; must be a number on your account.

fields.description: Structured fields to extract from the call.

listenFirst.description: If true, stay silent until the callee/IVR speaks first, then respond. Recommended for any outbound call into a phone tree.

navMode.description: How to navigate the far-end IVR: auto (detect keypad menu vs conversational assistant live), keypad (stay muted and press keys), or speech (talk).

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164, e.g. +14155550123.

toolAllowlist.description: Tools this call may use, e.g. ["send_digits","reached_human","add_participant","enter_account_number"]. Omit for the default set.

webhookUrl.description: Optional https URL to receive the signed result.

name: place_call
title: Place an AI phone call
